headline: Bank of Canada Lifts Its Policy Rate to 2.5%
deck: Canada’s central bank made its first rate increase since 2023, citing persistent inflation pressures.
body: The Bank of Canada raised its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5% on Wednesday, setting the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45%. [E1] [E2]
The Financial Post reported that the decision was the central bank’s first rate increase since 2023 and was driven by higher, more persistent inflation. [E2]
